description: Returns aggregated results for one survey: response and completion counts, and per question the answer counts, average rating, NPS (promoters minus detractors) and the latest written answers. No contact identities. Free and read only. Summarize trends in plain words; do not over-read small samples. Requires API key scope: read.

survey_id.description: Survey id (a UUID), as returned by survey_create or surveys_list.

name: survey_results
title: Survey results
